text:
Samira: Quick post — clearing out some desk gear before moving. Up for grabs: a pair of matching 27\" 144Hz IPS monitors (DP + HDMI, VESA), a Huion Kamvas 13 drawing tablet (works fine), and two GA tickets to Neon Nights at The Fillmore next Sat. Prefer local pickup SF but can ship at buyer cost. First-come, first-served.

Ethan W: Are the monitors the curved model? Curious about stand height adjust.

Samira: @Ethan W theyre flat 27\" (model: KX-2724), both have height & tilt, not swivel. No dead pixels, I used them for coding + light gaming.

Priya (she/her): Interested in the tablet if it's still around. Any stylus wear? Comes with pen?

Samira: @Priya yes pen included, nibs fine, has one tiny scratch near the corner (see pic). I'll include the charger and original cable.

Alex - Facilities: If someone needs help moving the monitors we have the two-person dolly and can reserve 10-10:30am tomorrow to help. Storage B has extra packing blankets if you need them.

Mika: I'll take the two concert tickets if @Priya doesn't want them. I can meet Fri midday.

Priya (she/her): I actually only want the tablet, @Mika take the tix. Thanks!

Samira: Cool: tablet -> @Priya, tickets -> @Mika. Monitors still up for grabs. Willing to trade monitors for a solid sit-stand desk (40-48\") or accept pickup-only.

Ethan W: Hmm would trade a Jarvis 48\" for the monitors? It's lightly used. Pics if useful.

Samira: @Ethan W that could work. DM me pics of the Jarvis and we can swap if sizes match. If no trade, monitors are pick-up only (I can't ship both safely).

Mika: @Samira how do you want the tix transferred? Mobile pdf? I can Venmo $10 to cover the transfer if needed.

Samira: @Mika organizer accepts name change via their portal. $0 this time but appreciate the offer. I'll email the PDF and leave physical tickets at the front desk under "Mika".

Alex - Facilities: Noted. @Samira if you leave the monitors in storage B please label them and I'll put a temporary access code on the door for the taker tomorrow between 10-11.

remind-bot: Reminder set — "Samira: leave monitors in storage B if swap confirmed" at 2026-07-09 09:30.

Samira: Summary: tablet -> @Priya (pickup tomorrow), tix -> @Mika (front desk), monitors pending trade with @Ethan W (or pickup-only). Will update thread after DMs. Thanks all! :sparkles:
